subagent: Subagent 4: Tax Certificate, Paid Contract & Completed Works Act Inquisitor
completed_steps: Audited all files in scope byte-by-byte
Fixed TaxDeductionModalFooter.tsx button text & title to match official form 'Печать справки КНД 1151156 (А4)'
Implemented Net Paid arithmetic in taxDeductionEngine.ts: subtracts partial refunds per code (Code 01 standard vs Code 02 expensive)
Implemented strict calendar year isolation (01.01–31.12) in taxDeductionEngine.ts and TaxDeductionCertificateModal.tsx
Wrapped XML (Order 824@, NO_MEDOPL 5.01) and HTML generation in taxDeductionEngine.ts with normalized payments to prevent multi-year leaks and unnetted sums
Fixed Completed Works Act in invoiceEngine.ts: filtered out refunded/cancelled items and derived kopecks in numberToWordsRu to prevent kopeck loss in words
Fixed Completed Works Act Form in CompletedWorksActForm.tsx: protected placeholders against NaN/non-finite numbers
Fixed Paid Medical Services Contract in paidContractEngine.ts: isolated Patient (Consumer) vs Customer (Payer) requisites in printed forms to prevent overwriting patient passport with payer passport
Extended PaidServiceContractForm.tsx with fresh patient requisites props and propagation to createDefaultPaidContract
Added comprehensive unit test suite in taxDeductionCertificateAutonomy.test.tsx covering calendar year isolation, 100k - 20k = 80k net paid, XML and HTML integrity
Executed full test suite (16/16 tests passing, exit code 0)
Executed per-file git add for all modified files in scope
findings: Multi-year leak was present in TaxDeductionCertificateModal.tsx where getCertificateParams passed unfiltered payments instead of yearPayments.
Refunds were previously dropped by Math.max(0, ...) in tax calculation; now taxDeductionEngine calculates Net Paid per Code 1 and Code 2.
Completed Works Act numberToWordsRu truncated kopecks if amountKopecks was omitted; now kopecks are derived from amountRub and passed explicitly from totalNetKopecks.

Paid Medical Services Contract in paidContractEngine.ts erroneously displayed customer passport under Patient header when customer was a 3rd-party payer; now distinct Patient vs Customer blocks are rendered.
